claims.title: Clans coalesce into kingdoms
claims.summary: Across the highlands, clans containing Hutu, Tutsi and Twa form into small kingdoms; the Nyiginya dynasty of the Tutsi begins to extend its authority, founding the kingdom of Rwanda.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1400-clans-coalesce-into-kingdoms, claim TL:RWA:event:1400:clans-coalesce-into-kingdoms, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: A centralised Tutsi-led state
claims.summary: A single kingdom under a Tutsi mwami controls much of present-day Rwanda, governing through clan chiefs and cattle-clientship arrangements such as ubuhake.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1700-a-centralised-tutsi-led-state, claim TL:RWA:event:1700:a-centralised-tutsi-led-state, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Reign of Kigeri IV Rwabugiri
claims.summary: Mwami Kigeri IV Rwabugiri expands the kingdom through military conquest and administrative reform toward Lake Kivu, marking the high point of precolonial Rwandan power.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1867-reign-of-kigeri-iv-rwabugiri, claim TL:RWA:event:1867:reign-of-kigeri-iv-rwabugiri, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Death of Rwabugiri
claims.summary: Rwabugiri dies during a campaign, just as European powers reach the central African interior; a disputed succession leaves the kingdom weakened on the eve of colonial rule.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1895-death-of-rwabugiri, claim TL:RWA:event:1895:death-of-rwabugiri, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: First European contact
claims.summary: The German explorer Count Gustav Adolf von Götzen reaches the Rwandan court; Rwanda is incorporated into German East Africa and ruled indirectly through the mwami.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1894-first-european-contact, claim TL:RWA:event:1894:first-european-contact, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Belgium occupies Rwanda
claims.summary: Belgian forces take Rwanda from Germany during the First World War; from 1922 it is governed with Burundi as Ruanda-Urundi under a League of Nations mandate.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1916-belgium-occupies-rwanda, claim TL:RWA:event:1916:belgium-occupies-rwanda, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Belgians depose Mwami Musinga
claims.summary: The Belgian administration removes the uncooperative King Yuhi V Musinga and installs his son Mutara III Rudahigwa, tightening colonial control over the monarchy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1931-belgians-depose-mwami-musinga, claim TL:RWA:event:1931:belgians-depose-mwami-musinga, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ethnic identity cards introduced
claims.summary: Belgium issues identity cards classifying every Rwandan as Hutu, Tutsi or Twa, fixing a once-fluid social distinction into a rigid, inherited racial category.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background
Indangamuntu 1994: The role of the identity card in the genocide

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1933-ethnic-identity-cards-introduced, claim TL:RWA:event:1933:ethnic-identity-cards-introduced, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Hutu Manifesto
claims.summary: Hutu leaders publish the 'Hutu Manifesto' demanding an end to Tutsi domination; Belgian authorities and the Church begin to favour the Hutu majority over the Tutsi elite.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1957-the-hutu-manifesto, claim TL:RWA:event:1957:the-hutu-manifesto, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Hutu 'Social Revolution'
claims.summary: A Hutu uprising, tolerated by the Belgian authorities, kills hundreds of Tutsi and drives many into exile, breaking the power of the Tutsi monarchy.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1959-the-hutu-social-revolution, claim TL:RWA:event:1959:the-hutu-social-revolution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Monarchy abolished by referendum
claims.summary: A UN-supervised referendum abolishes the monarchy and rejects King Kigeri V; Grégoire Kayibanda's Parmehutu wins the concurrent elections.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1961-monarchy-abolished-by-referendum, claim TL:RWA:event:1961:monarchy-abolished-by-referendum, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Independence from Belgium
claims.summary: Rwanda becomes a sovereign republic with Grégoire Kayibanda as first president, ending Belgian rule of Ruanda-Urundi; Burundi gains independence the same day.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1962-independence-from-belgium, claim TL:RWA:event:1962:independence-from-belgium, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Reprisals against the Tutsi
claims.summary: An incursion by Tutsi exiles is met with mass killings of Tutsi civilians and a further exodus, setting a pattern of cyclical anti-Tutsi violence.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1963-reprisals-against-the-tutsi, claim TL:RWA:event:1963:reprisals-against-the-tutsi, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Habyarimana seizes power
claims.summary: Defence minister Juvénal Habyarimana overthrows President Kayibanda in a coup and establishes a one-party state under the MRND.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1973-habyarimana-seizes-power, claim TL:RWA:event:1973:habyarimana-seizes-power, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: RPF invasion begins the civil war
claims.summary: The Rwandan Patriotic Front, composed largely of Tutsi exiles from Uganda, invades northern Rwanda, igniting a civil war and intensifying official anti-Tutsi propaganda.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1990-rpf-invasion-begins-the-civil-war, claim TL:RWA:event:1990:rpf-invasion-begins-the-civil-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Arusha Accords signed
claims.summary: Government and RPF sign the Arusha peace agreement promising power-sharing and refugee return; a UN force (UNAMIR) deploys, but extremists reject the deal and plan genocide.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1993-arusha-accords-signed, claim TL:RWA:event:1993:arusha-accords-signed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Habyarimana's plane shot down
claims.summary: A surface-to-air missile downs the plane carrying President Habyarimana and Burundi's president over Kigali, killing all aboard; extremists seize on it to unleash the genocide.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda and the United Nations

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1994-habyarimana-s-plane-shot-down, claim TL:RWA:event:1994:habyarimana-s-plane-shot-down, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The killing begins
claims.summary: Within hours of the plane crash, the Presidential Guard and Interahamwe militias begin murdering Tutsi and moderate Hutu in Kigali, using roadblocks and prepared lists; the violence spreads nationwide.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda and the United Nations
The Genocide
sources.publisher: United Nations International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (IRMCT)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1994-the-killing-begins, claim TL:RWA:event:1994:the-killing-begins, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Genocide against the Tutsi
claims.summary: Over roughly 100 days an estimated 800,000 to one million people, overwhelmingly Tutsi, are systematically murdered, and an estimated 150,000–250,000 women are raped.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda and the United Nations
Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background
The Genocide
sources.publisher: United Nations International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (IRMCT)

claims.title: RPF victory ends the genocide
claims.summary: Paul Kagame's Rwandan Patriotic Front captures Kigali and most of the country by mid-July, defeating the genocidal regime and halting the mass killing.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1994-rpf-victory-ends-the-genocide, claim TL:RWA:event:1994:rpf-victory-ends-the-genocide, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Refugee crisis and the Congo wars
claims.summary: Over a million Hutu flee to camps in Zaire and beyond; the presence of armed génocidaires there draws Rwanda into the Congo wars from 1996, which kill millions across the region.

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda — Historical Background

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1994-refugee-crisis-and-the-congo-wars, claim TL:RWA:event:1994:refugee-crisis-and-the-congo-wars, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda
claims.summary: The UN Security Council establishes the ICTR in Arusha, which indicts 93 people and delivers landmark genocide convictions before closing in 2015.

sources.label: The Genocide
sources.publisher: United Nations International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (IRMCT)

sources.label: Outreach Programme on the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda and the United Nations

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-1994-international-criminal-tribunal-for-rwanda, claim TL:RWA:event:1994:international-criminal-tribunal-for-rwanda, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The gacaca community courts
claims.summary: Rwanda revives the traditional gacaca courts to try genocide cases locally; by their closure in June 2012 they have heard more than 1.9 million cases.

sources.label: Justice after genocide: Rwanda's journey toward accountability and healing

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-2002-the-gacaca-community-courts, claim TL:RWA:event:2002:the-gacaca-community-courts, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Kagame becomes president
claims.summary: Paul Kagame formally assumes the presidency and consolidates power, presiding over reconstruction and growth alongside tight control of political life.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Rwanda: From the kingdom of the mwami to genocide, reckoning and rebuilding.", terralore.co/country/RWA/chronicle#ev-2000-kagame-becomes-president, claim TL:RWA:event:2000:kagame-becomes-president, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
